tools.headerDesc: Acoustic Tuner · Rhythm Metronome · Drone Sound · Reed Doctor · Breathing Coach · Score Arranger
tools.tunerDesc: Automatically detects bassoon double reed pitch with intuitive embouchure correction guidance
tools.pitchAdviceGood: Airflow is stable and supported. Maintain current embouchure cushion and throat openness!
tools.tunerGuide1Title: 1. Always Warm Up Instrument for 3 Mins
tools.tunerGuide1Desc: Bassoon wooden body is dense. A cold instrument naturally plays 15-20 cents flat until thoroughly warmed up.
tools.tunerGuide2Desc: If consistently sharp, pull bocal out by 1-2mm. If consistently flat, push bocal fully in.
tools.tunerGuide3Title: 3. Cushion with Lips, Never Bite the Reed
tools.tunerGuide3Desc: Biting causes sharp intonation and a thin, pinched tone. Wrap the reed gently with lip cushions like a sponge.
tools.bocal1Desc: Shorter length, ideal for cold environments
tools.bocal3Desc: Longer length, ideal for warm environments
tools.bocalPhysicsTip: 💡 Physical Rule: For every 5°C increase in ambient temperature, speed of sound increases, raising overall pitch by ~5-8 cents.
tools.correctionLowSharpDesc: Jaw biting too tight. Drop jaw slightly, open oral cavity as if holding a warm egg.
tools.correctionHighFlatDesc: Insufficient airflow speed. Engage core abdominal support, bringing lip cushion toward mid-reed.
tools.dronesQuickTitle: One-Touch Reference Long Tones (Auditory Ear Training):

tools.presetLongToneDesc: 4 beats in, 4 beats out for solid tone envelope
tools.presetTonguingDesc: Light tongue on tip, crisp like water droplets
tools.presetAllegroDesc: Progressive steps to build mental milestones
tools.masterMethodSlowDesc: Check if fingers lift too high; eliminate transition noise and airflow gaps.
tools.masterMethodSolidDesc: Incorporate rhythmic breath pulses; use core rebound for internal groove.
tools.masterMethodSprintDesc: Unimpeded continuous airflow with completely relaxed musculature at tempo.
tools.dronePureTitle: Just Intonation Drone & Long Tone Training
tools.dronePureDesc: Use woodwind root tones to eliminate acoustic beating, fostering keen harmonic awareness

tools.droneTimerDesc: Daily 10 minutes of steady tone builds a warm woodwind resonance
tools.droneEarBeatingDesc: Small frequency differences create audible pulsating waves. Micro-adjust embouchure until pulses slow to a standstill for perfect intonation.
tools.droneThirdDesc: Just major 3rds must sit slightly lower
tools.reedDoctorDesc: Never scrape blindly! Select your playing symptom to pinpoint exact micro-scrape zones and solutions

tools.arrangingLoading: Using Gemini to generate beginner-adapted bass clef score...
tools.arrangerLaw1Desc: Avoids complex thumb high register keys or full-tube low keys; directly maps to tone holes.
tools.arrangerLaw2Title: 2. Recommended Keys (F Major / C Major / Bb Major)
tools.arrangerLaw2Desc: Minimal accidentals, steering clear of awkward 4+ sharp/flat cross-fingerings.
tools.arrangerLaw3Desc: Bassoon is a non-transposing bass instrument; AI intelligently transposes down an octave to avoid excessive ledger lines.
tools.evaluatorDesc: Record 10-15s of practice audio or describe your challenge. AI mentor provides actionable mechanical advice on pitch, rhythm, and attack
tools.recordingHint: Play a scale or excerpt steadily 30-50cm from your microphone
tools.evalNotesPlaceholder: e.g., F major octave legato scale, Mozart K.191 Allegro
tools.evalDim1Desc: Assesses crisp reed initiation, eliminating biting that causes squeaks or sluggish attack.
tools.evalDim2Desc: Evaluates pitch jitter and amplitude consistency, guiding core diaphragm support.
tools.evalDim3Desc: Checks finger lift height during legato passages to ensure round, woodwind tone continuity.
tools.breathDesc: Follow the animated sphere expanding and contracting: 4s deep inhale, 2s pressure hold, 8s controlled steady exhale to build a resonant woodwind air column.
tools.breathTipHold: Lock air column with diaphragm lowered
tools.breathFftTitle: Real-time Airflow Stability Waveform (Audio FFT Spectrum)
tools.breathFftDesc: When sustaining a long tone, the waveform should display a continuous, steady rectangular contour without erratic spikes, showing balanced core pressure and clean timbre.
tools.breathMottoDesc: “Inhale as if smelling a flower, expanding the waist all around; exhale as if blowing out a candle two meters away, supported firmly by the core.”
